类 AuditLogStorage

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.storage.AuditLogStorage
public class AuditLogStorage extends Object
JSON file storage manager for audit logs.

Responsible for recording audit logs of user operations in the system, supporting log addition, querying, and automatic cleanup (logs older than one year are automatically pruned).

    • query

      public List<AuditLogEntry> query(String operator, String actionType, Instant from, Instant to)
      Queries audit logs by operator, action type, and time range.
      参数:
      operator - the operator (supports fuzzy matching; ignored if null or blank)
      actionType - the action type (case-insensitive; ignored if null or blank)
      from - the start time (inclusive; ignored if null)
      to - the end time (inclusive; ignored if null)
      返回:
      the list of matching audit log entries
